invalidated_scope: all GOUT-FAVORABLE, GOUT-UNFAVORABLE, GOUT-NEUTRAL, MECHANISM-UNCLEAR, uniqueness, and H-AN-02 partially-falsified verdicts
all candidate rankings, evidence-cell counts, cross-candidate comparisons, candidate priorities, genotype-aware selection implications, and head-to-head design claims derived from the matrix

the compound-by-target evidence matrix as a commensurate model, including its ordinal evidence weights, favorable-keyword direction parser, negative-screen handling, and one-hit categorical decision rule
all achievable-concentration, IC50-ratio, fractional-inhibition, target-coverage, and five-target-panel-completeness conclusions, including the false attribution of local ratio thresholds to COMP-007
all substitutions of Eurycoma longifolia extract, mixed or isolated quassinoids, purified eurycomanol, Physta, and pure eurycomanone as one material or one evidence object
the claim that the 2021 Physta trial established a serum-urate treatment effect or connected the safety-laboratory urate values to eurycomanone, eurycomanol, transporter modulation, or PRPS

statements: Purified cordycepin at 15, 30, and 60 mg/kg lowered serum urate relative to hyperuricemic control and reduced renal URAT1 mRNA and protein in a mouse hyperuricemia model in PMID 29422889; human exposure, human urate lowering, and an androgen-urate dual benefit remain unestablished.

A 70% ethanol Eurycoma longifolia stem extract at 100, 200, and 400 mg/kg altered renal urate transporters in hyperuricemic rodents in PMID 31920654; in hURAT1-expressing cells, eurycomanol-type compounds 4-7 at 50 micromolar inhibited urate uptake, while pure eurycomanone was compound 3 and showed comparatively low activity. The extract and eurycomanol results do not establish a pure-eurycomanone cross-target verdict.

Purified eurycomanol at 5-20 mg/kg orally lowered serum urate, increased urate clearance, decreased hepatic PRPS expression, and modulated renal and intestinal urate transporters in hyperuricemic mice in PMID 34785103; human efficacy and a Physta mechanism remain unestablished.

The 2021 Physta trial reported urate only as a safety outcome; week-12 between-group comparisons versus placebo were p=0.88 for 100 mg and p=0.52 for 200 mg, so the table does not establish a Physta urate-treatment effect.

Whether a defined cordyceps or Eurycoma preparation can produce a reproducible androgen effect together with a favorable urate-axis effect remains an untested Research Conjecture requiring matched material identity, measured exposure, and direct urate and transporter endpoints.
